commercial_product.note: GE HealthCare is a diversified medical-imaging and patient-care company. Major commercial categories include MR, CT, ultrasound, X-ray and molecular imaging systems, patient-care monitoring solutions, and a Pharmaceutical Diagnostics franchise (e.g., Omnipaque, Visipaque iodinated CT contrast; Optison ultrasound contrast; Clariscan/Optimark MRI contrast; Datscan, Vizamyl, Cerianna PET tracers; Myoview SPECT tracer; Rapiscan/Lexiscan stress agent). These approved/marketed products are out of scope for the active P1/P2/P3 pipeline list above.

excluded_legacy_terminated: 12 TERMINATED, 4 WITHDRAWN, 1 UNKNOWN-status historical company-sponsored studies (mostly Visipaque, Omnipaque, Optison, Datscan, Vizamyl post-marketing or label-extension trials).
excluded_partner_owned: Investigator-initiated trials and academic-sponsored studies that use GE HealthCare imaging agents but where GEHC is not the lead sponsor (e.g., Duke, MD Anderson, Brigham and Women's, Mass General, NCI, etc.).
